title: Dark's Armor Control
description: This plugin allow you to enable or disable netherite and more
body:
![Dark's Armor Control](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7423646c00a174c3fa7919b4ffc15a9ae0dc223.png)
- **This plugin is perfect for PvP SMPs. It essentially adds a few features to armor tools and weapons, which are as follows:**

### Netherite
- You can disable or enable to have Netherite tools armor and weapons on your server
### Enchant 
- You can change the enchantments and enchantment levels of an armor 

<details>
<summary>Example</summary>

EXAMPLE:
if you enter 
**/armor enchant protection 4 disable**
that means you cannot be able to use protection 4 it turns into protection 3

</details>

## Commands
- /armor
